paragraphs.text: Kobold is a red and black creature type which was featured in Legends as Kobolds , and had brief reappearances since. They are a species of little creatures, resembling a cross between a goblin and an imp . They have red or green skins.

There is only one known plane inhabited by kobolds: Dominaria . They live in the fortress of Kher Keep in the Kher Ridges on Terisiare , and in the Red Iron Mountains on Aerona . The Crookshank kobolds of the Red Iron Mountains once had a standing army numbering 2–46 million. Kobolds seem to be incredibly resilient, as they survived for centuries in their lairs, unafflicted by the disasters that ravaged the other parts of Dominaria. For this, Teferi compared them to cockroaches. Besides their broodlords, kobolds are generally considered unintelligent. They have a weak sense of smell but can see in the dark and are often active at night, especially at dusk.

Entire regions were destroyed by the kobolds, but not because of their superior battle tactics - when kobolds are hungry enough, they will eat anything that isn't made of rock. The Kobold Musketeers are an organized unit of kobolds. Several kobolds were summoned by Shauku (whom they called the Yellow Lady) to tend the fires guarding the Cosmic Horror imprisoned in her castle, in south-western Jamuraa .

The Kobolds of the Kher Ridges survived into the period of the Terisian Isles , and came to revere the dragon Prossh as a god . They are known to offer themselves to the dragon in the hope that he will spare their kin.
